statement.text:
Let Φ ∈ Out G = Aut G/Inn G. Two automorphisms φ, ψ ∈ Φ are said to be
isogradient if φ = ĝ −1 ψĝ for some inner automorphism ĝ. The number of isogradiency
classes in Φ is denoted by S(Φ).
    Conjecture: If a finitely generated residually finite group G has an outer automor-
phism Φ such that S(Φ) is finite, then G has a soluble subgroup of finite index.
                                                          A. L. Fel’shtyn, E. V. Troitsky
